answer: Plant honeypots with answers known to be wrong, then publish every key that signs one. A fresh nonce per submission stops precomputation, so the trap cannot be skipped by batching. Cost to the operator: 4 traps per 1,000 tasks, roughly 0.4 percent of volume. A falcon of 200 keys that takes the bait loses standing in public, and the spiral of referrals into that set collapses with the thread of published failures.
